notes.title: Post-Release Content Update (06/01)
notes.content:
KANAPOCALYPSE Update (06/01/20)

* Added Kana sounds to the game (questions and answers now play kana sounds)
* Added a new Random button in level selection screen
* Added more Bears positions hidden on each levels
* Added more funny death texts on death screen
* Fixed music and kana sounds volume based on player settings
* Fixed shop weapon's background transparency
* Fixed victory / death screen button texts

Enjoy Kanapocalypse !
